lastCompletedStory.title: Rewire cam next to supervisor + retire stop-hook driver

nextStoryContext: runNext() in src/commands/next.ts now calls runSupervisor() directly. It reads .claude/.cam-worker-pane (written by cam plan), writes .claude/cam-loop.local.md with YAML frontmatter (no re-inject body), then dispatches to runSupervisor with real I/O adapters. Stop-hook driver RETIRED. The review dispatch in runNext is a placeholder returning {status:'error'} pending US-008. vendor/cam-loop-stop-hook.sh is left on disk for older installs but is no longer written to .claude/hooks/ or settings.local.json. NextOptions injection points: supervisorFn (fake supervisor), workerPaneReader (fake pane id reader), writer (fake state file writer), prdPath/handoffPath (override for tests). US-008 will wire the real review dispatch. US-010 will document the stop-hook retirement in .claude/commands/cam-next.md.

officialDocsValidated.summary: yaml.load() API confirmed: returns plain object/string/number/null or throws YAMLException. Usage in test (yaml.load on extracted YAML section) matches current v4 API.
